payload.summary: The page a business lands on when it wants a premises licence in Norwich: who can apply, what to send in, and how to vary, transfer or give up a licence afterwards. It links out to the licensing policy under 'Related links', which is how we found that document. The link tells you which policy the council points applicants to; it does not itself give a date.
